# Feature: Fixture Playwright E2E Smoke

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 -->

## Intent
Browser MCP cannot reach loopback. `pnpm test:e2e` must start the Three.js fixture in-process and prove it loads, toggles `?problem=`, and makes no external network requests — so verify-ui has a real browser gate without the dashboard.

Roadmap: Epic 8 / Epic 2 — quality gate for T-001, T-004 (fixture starts; toggleable problem).

## Preconditions
- `fixtures/web-threejs` exists (#17)
- Chromium is available via `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`

## Happy Path
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` starts the fixture and the baseline page shows `problem: none` plus a canvas
- [ ] `?problem=drawcalls` shows overlay `problem: drawcalls`
- [ ] `?problem=longtask` and `?problem=alloc` show their overlay labels
- [ ] Fixture page issues no requests off 127.0.0.1 / localhost
- [ ] CI runs `pnpm test:e2e` as a separate job (not inside `pnpm checks`)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Unknown `?problem=` falls back to `problem: none`
- [ ] Reusing a local Vite server is allowed outside CI (`reuseExistingServer`)

## Regression
- [ ] `pnpm checks` stays lint/typecheck/unit/audit only — e2e does not slow the unit gate
- [ ] CLI `detect fixtures/web-threejs` still returns web/vite/react/threejs candidates

## Assumptions
- Dashboard is not scaffolded; e2e covers the fixture only
- Chromium-only is enough until dashboard a11y (#26) needs extra projects
- Fixture joins the pnpm workspace so CI `pnpm install` provides Vite

## Security Coverage
- F-01 N/A (loopback fixture, no TLS)
- F-02: query param is a closed whitelist (`none|drawcalls|longtask|alloc`); unknown → baseline
- F-03/F-05: no tokens, no API keys in fixture or e2e
- B-01–B-09 N/A (no API, no auth)
- P-02: Playwright failure output is test assertion messages, not product stderr
- P-04 N/A (no uploads)
- Potato-Boost: no shell-string interpolation; webServer argv is a pnpm filter command; fixture stays offline

## Implementation Notes
- Playwright Chromium smoke in `e2e/fixture-web-threejs.spec.ts`; config starts the workspace fixture on 127.0.0.1:5199.
- Fixture overlay/canvas now live on `document.body` so `createRoot(#root)` cannot wipe them (this was a real blank-page bug).
- `pnpm checks` stays unit-only; CI has a separate `e2e` job with `playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
- Local first run: `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`.
